name: Wizard OS 0.3.73 — 0.3.72 with automatic app updates
about: Latest 0.3.72 plus automatic app updates (wizard-app-manager #305). Every night the App Manager checks the apps installed from the Wizard App Index and updates each one that has a new version, one at a time: it backs the app up first, checks it works afterwards (same running or stopped state, new version, containers up, its health check or MCP endpoint answers) and puts the backup back if it does not. The owner gets one Notifications line saying what was updated or kept back. This is on by default (Automatic) and separate from the Wizard OS update setting; `wam app-updates --ask` turns it off and `--hold <app>` keeps one app where it is. It never moves the shell, the Agent Service, Hermes or the apps this release pins: those still move only with Wizard OS releases. App Manager is 0.3.72's 08b54f65 plus only that feature (maintenance commit 68ed4a26); the App Manager image, Wizard UX, Agent Service, Notifications, Troubleshooter, Hermes and every default app are exactly 0.3.72's. The App Manager image fix for apps whose prepared source copy went missing (also in #305) needs a new image and waits for a later release; until then such an app's update fails, is undone the usual way (old version kept, or restored from its backup) and reported, and is retried after 7 days.

modes.fresh: blank Ubuntu/Debian box: Runtipi + App Manager + the default app in every spot (including hermes-agent)
modes.alongside: box that already runs Hermes (run as its owner): App Manager + apps + the Wizard shell pointed at that Hermes; `wizard link` connects it, `wizard unlink` reverses it byte for byte

install.note: Fresh and alongside installs both take every default app at the source commit pinned below, and the Wizard UX and Agent Service images at the digests above; the installer reads back what runs (a default app on another source commit fails; index versions are informational and reported as drift). No catalog release is changed by this snapshot.

wizard-app-manager.note: 0.3.72 App Manager 08b54f65 plus only the Python/host part of wizard-app-manager #305 (automatic app updates: wam/app_updates.py, `wam app-updates`, /api/app-updates, the installer's `wam updates --ensure-timer` also enables wizard-app-updates.timer; tests and docs), cherry-picked from 2985b046. Rollback skips network reconcile on this line (no app network isolation here). Plus wizard-app-manager #307 (68ed4a26): the health/MCP check after an update is required only when it answered before the update, found by this release's upgrade test (morning-report's /healthz answers 403 from loopback, so every working update of it was rolled back). No backend/image input changes (packages/**, Dockerfile, package.json, bun.lock, turbo.json, image.yml byte-identical to 08b54f65); the #305 backend source-copy fix and unrelated main changes are excluded.
